- Introduced a bilingual workflow and description (Chinese/English), plus a clear methodology section ("Wisdom Reframe" process).
- Clarified appropriate and inappropriate use cases, with a comprehensive precision statement and FAQ.
- Emphasized practical, actionable insights (not academic, predictive, or data-driven outputs).
- Updated description and version number to reflect broadened capabilities and clearer guidance.
